Floating Music Studio

This is a floating producer studio scavenger hunt. Use your mouse to look around the studio and click the music item shown in the top-left game panel.

You get 10 seconds each round to find the keyboard, mic stand, mic, vinyl, headphones, boombox, or record player.

Floating Music Studio

A Desmond-style producer room floating in the sky.

Mouse: orbit, zoom, pan, and click the target item.

Find: Press Start Game

Time: 10

Rounds Won: 0

Each round gives you one random item to find.
